long_description:
This will be our 10th meeting of the Bay area Hindi Urdu poetry open Mic Mehfil.

RSVP Here 

 https://www.meetup.com/mountain-view-open-mics-stories-meetup-group/events/315808943/

Chaliye, shuru karte hain.

This is it, another evening for poetic minds to connect and celebrate poetery - Hindi Poetry Open Mic in the South Bay. We’re gathering at the Cuesta Park, Mountain view for an evening of Hindi kavita .

Here’s how it works:

Show up by 2:00 PM. We’ll settle in, do quick intros, and kick off the open mic. Sign up on the spot if you’d like to share — you get 3-5 minutes to read original work, recite a classic, or share anything that moves you. Prefer to just listen? That’s equally welcome. Every mehfil needs its audience. After the event we will host an informal get together at a resturant.

What to bring:

Yourself. Maybe a poem. Maybe just your ears. If you want to go the extra mile, bring a blanket or a chair to sit on and some chai in a thermos — we’re keeping this simple.

Who is this for?

Anyone who loves poetry — whether you write it, read it, or just feel it. If you grew up hearing kavita at home, if you scribble shayari in your Notes app, if you’ve been looking for your people — this is the space.

Logistics:

We’ll in the park, look for the group with the obvious poetry energy. Free parking is available on surrounding streets. The park closes at 9 PM but we’ll wrap up by 4:30 pm 

Also check out other Arts events in Sunnyvale, Literary Art events in Sunnyvale.
